timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Are you aware that the gas giants Jupiter and Saturn are often referred to as failed stars due to their composition and size?
While Jupiter and Saturn are much larger than terrestrial planets like Earth, they lack the critical mass needed to sustain nuclear fusion in their cores.
As a result, they are classified as gas giants rather than true stars.

youtube_description: Dive into the intriguing realm of the gas giants, Jupiter and Saturn, as we uncover the mysteries behind their colossal presence in our solar system. Despite their immense size and captivating beauty, these planetary behemoths hold a secret—they are often dubbed "failed stars." Join us on an exploration of their composition, structure, and the factors that distinguish them from true stars. From their stunning rings to their enigmatic atmospheres, discover why Jupiter and Saturn continue to fascinate astronomers and space enthusiasts alike.
